observations.behavior: Adds a try/except block around _recovery_sweep_with_timeout() in BatchConsumer.run() to catch psycopg.OperationalError and other exceptions, converting them into logged warnings rather than propagating them to crash the consumer.
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents the BatchConsumer from crashing during startup if the database queue is temporarily unavailable, allowing the recovery loop and subsequent polling to proceed. This supports warehouse ingestion reliability by distinguishing transient startup failures from permanent ones.
